shortDescription: Download an existing configuration from AOS-CX switch.

options.name: config_name
options.description: Config file or checkpoint to be downloaded. When using TFTP only running-config or startup-config can be used.

options.name: config_type
options.description: Configuration type to be downloaded, JSON or CLI version of the config.

options.name: output_file
options.description: File name and path for locally downloading configuration, only JSON version of configuration will be downloaded.

options.name: remote_output_file_tftp_path
options.description: TFTP server address and path for copying off configuration, must be reachable through provided vrf.

options.name: sort_json
options.description: flag whether or not to sort JSON config

options.name: vrf
options.description: VRF to be used to contact TFTP server, required if remote_output_file_tftp_path is provided.
